entities.summary: Mikhail Aleksandrovich Vasiliev is a retired ice hockey player who played in the Soviet Hockey League. He played for Torpedo Yaroslavl and HC CSKA Moscow in the Soviet Union, and for HC Selva, EV Bozen 84, AS Mastini Varese Hockey and HC Bolzano in Italy. He played for a season (1997–98) in Denmark for Rødovre IK, too. He was inducted into the Russian and Soviet Hockey Hall of Fame in 1983.
